This game has the potential to become a 4Player coop gem and I hope it does.
Even in its rough state, it is better than back 4 blood.  Is it worth 29.99? Probably not if you are looking for a full game, but if you are like me and have been waiting for your next left 4 dead style game, this is a game worth investing in. I consider my purchase an investment in the devs to pimp this game out.

UPDATE: 
Not sure what went wrong with this one. 
I had high hopes. 2 years later + xbox gamepass money and still feels unfinished. 
Bummer!

UPDATE: They have added in Offline and Private play :D

This game has so much potential and promise! The developers have been extremely transparent about what their plans are and have not disappointed so far. My only problem is that I cannot play in Singleplayer or local games yet... But they do plan on adding more gameplay options in the future as the game is still in a very early stage. If it wasnt for the bad ping I'd be playing this game way more often. This honestly feels like the closest thing to a L4D game that Ive played in a long time. Keep up the good work!

Something So Good & Close to Left 4 Dead After a long long time thats worth playing,
One thing that even stands out more than l4d is that The Balance of power between both sides are so stable.
The map Designs,artwork and vibe of this game  along with the Survivor Mechanics and the special infected  are just so great. In Detail-

The Survivor Mechancis-
-------------------------------
I.The survivors instead of shove got Plasma Shoves that they can use 3 times That just shoves every alien in a circular shape which also recharge while you are not using them

II. There are matter compilers across the levels where you can get perks for your characters like Faster Healing,Blaster amplifier,more ammo for your guns,Critical hits and many more(there's like 25-30 such perks)

III.You can pinpoint(mouse wheel) every special infected or any health kit,health booster,weapons or grenade so your team mates know exactly where everything is  or you can also  just poke at each other for fun they start calling each other stuff.

IV.Survivors Got 3  Main Primary weapons. 
a.The Blaster is literally a shotgun.
B.the plasma rifle is a rifle
C.The SMB is a SMG

V.Survivors Got 3 Special Weapons. 
A.You Can Literally Plant Sentry Guns against zombies like engineer of tf2,Its one of the most fun thing in the game when you are about to fight a big horde.
B.You Can use a Laser Rifle that has unlimited range and can pierce through everything.
C.You Got an Arc Rifle that is just auto aimlock weapon thats good against normal aliens but not the special infected.


VI.Survivors Got 6 Different Grenades and boi are they not fun to use.
 A.There's a grenade that slows down aliens movement(GOO-Grenade) ,
 B.There's a grenade that makes every alien get sucked into a black hole vaccum and then explode (Vortex Grenade)(kinda similar to pipe-bomb),
C.There's Stasis Grenades that create a pocket of Stasis, slowing anything that comes into contact with the bubble several times faster and their attack speed too
D.There's Shield Grenades push out weaker aliens and create a pocket of safety — almost nothing can breach the shield, allowing you time to revive or heal.They work similar to the 3 charge shove you got but a long duration.
E&F. The incendiary and impact grenades are pretty self-explanatory.

THE SPECIAL INFECTED-
--------------------------

1,The Grabber-A Smoker on Steroids and longer range to grab you.he can literally hook you from one side of map to other(Pro-Tip:You can use your plasma shove at the exact second he tries to grab you and his grabbing tentacles get cancelled out,Also Allies with plasma rifle can pick him out long range)

2.The Gooper-They Throw nasty stuff at ya that makes you paralyzed for any action.Also if they throw that nasty stuff on the ground it makes you slower to walk.(Pro-Tip:Your allies can get you out of Goo.Also Your Plasma Shove can make the goo he throw at you bounce off).

3.The spawner-An Alien that creates more aliens.(Pro-Tip:Find him in the back of the horde before he starts making too much)

4.The Flasher- Kinda Similar to Boomer but boi this one can blind you in real life you better pick him out whenever he comes screaming at ya.(Pro-Tip:Usually you can see a bit of a flower looking head coloured black when hes flashing look out for that)

5.Brute-A Tank that does more damage,spawns more frequently and can come in a pack of 2 or 3.(Pro-Tip:Use Stasis Grenades if you got.)

6.Eggs-The Witch of this game,they sleep on the floor in a pack of Eggs but if you disturb them you can expect insta downs real fast and real dangerous.(Pro Tip:They cant bypass shield grenades so you can easily pick em out in those shield grenades)

7.Common Aliens- Just something you will face the entire game at all times .We could use more variety of them.almost all look similar.

The Map Designs
------------------

You Literally have food cafes,A shopping mall where you have to climb 13 floors of,Beautiful big gardens,A disco,space stations also you can literally go up and down like some portal turbine vaccum in some places. and literally a SPACE AIRPORT that is similar to dead centre's mall all of this IN A CYBER SPACESHIP. The artstyle is really great and one of the biggest standout points for this game and for very few games i can say that their artwork,artsyle and vibe is so unique and great.

I suggest to look at my anacrusis screenshots if im unable to explain this part  so well.


I know its a late review 

But The Hate i see in the review sections just doesnt make any sense
They are the developers of l4d but they dont advertise it like back 4 blood.They dont charge you 60 bucks and completely abandon the game after a week.They made a game with SOLID FOUNDATIONS  with something to build on,It got strong bones and they are working on the muscle,and they are not letting it die just yet like most cash grab triple-a companies. They release a good sizeable big updates for stuff like free battlepass for everyone,one thing this game felt the lack of was the characters communication and not much lore or story was told but boy after 2 months again they are making cinematics for finale end of chapter 1..its rare to see devs work so hard for their game  i hope to see more. I dont want this game to die just yet,hell i saw so much promise for this game i brought 7 more copies and gave it to my friends that i used to play left 4 dead with 10 years ago  for free because they where hesitant it wasnt good but after playing with each other again after a long time they all had good and positive  things to say about it.Just weird that Pc dont have many players compared to XBOX. Me and my friends eagerly wait for chapter 4,5 and maybe a versus mode and that rocket launcher you got us promised at the end of battlepass and  many other new contents, So do keep showing us what you got Stray Bombay.

Incredibly fun with a lot of promise.
I definitely recommend if you've been looking for a fresh L4D fix.

Recommend, with a grain of salt. This game isn't a game that I enjoy playing by myself, and convincing people to spend almost $30 on an early access game is hard. That being said, I enjoy how the swarms change every time you play, and how easy it is for someone like me who never got into 1st person shooter games to handle the basics. I do wish there was more to interact with, but I'm hoping things like that will be added. I also have only experienced one bad community player who hopped in halfway through a game and team killed everyone during a swarm, but everyone else seems to be in it to actually play.

This is very inspired from the Left 4 Dead series, and VERY much worth a look.  The game has a lot of potential, and has a very well developed skill system with great synergies.  Have to say, I've found another game that is going to be part of my normal game rotation.

The mechanics feel great but seems to be a game that's only fun if you play with friends. Every lobby is the same. Teammates taking forever to start and everyone running around like chickens with their heads cut off. Not having a clue what to do. Too many people using the AFK feature but why get online and play a co-op game if you're going to be busy doing other things?

Can't play solo
No XP leveling system
No achievements

Seems pointless to play this game right now. Maybe in a year all of those things will be added and give you a reason to play and grind.
Love it! It's still rough around the edges but there's a great game here and it'll only get better with time. Plus, that soundtrack has no right being so good! ❤️
